sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Ki* means “who”. To ask who does something, put *ki* first and the verb right after it: *Ki olvas?* means “Who reads?” *Ki* stands for one person, so the verb is the plain stem, the same form you use for Anna or *ő*. It never takes *-ok* or *-sz*.

sections.title: Answering
sections.content: Answer with a name and the same verb: *Anna olvas.* A short answer is enough: *Anna.* or *Én.* After *én* the verb takes its “I” ending, as you know: *Én olvasok.*

items.english: Who is walking in the park?

sections.content: In a question with *ki*, a place or time word comes after the verb: *Ki sétál a parkban?* In a plain statement it comes before the verb: *Anna a parkban sétál.*
